sources.evidence: GetDC palette selection at2531-2542 uses surface own palette, otherwise primary palette, otherwise no palette. Selection affects DC only, not surface binding. This is the Wine fallback policy; native offscreen behavior may reflect the system palette.

Windows-tested BLACKNESS and WHITENESS at12363-12404 accept NULL source and preserve dwFillColor. Native32-bit WHITENESS alpha observed0; existing test masks alpha. GetDC offscreen initial primary/system palette at10360-10385; live changes on already-open DC explicitly not tested.

reference.scope: S2-57: translate BLACKNESS and WHITENESS to native-pixel fill before source validation; NULL and locked ignored sources succeed, SRCCOPY still requires a valid unlocked source, NULL fx and unsupported ROPs refused. Fill does not mutate caller fx/rect, preserves clipping, sync and presentation error prefixes. WHITENESS fills indexed255 or destination RGB masks, excludes ARGB alpha. P8 GetDC snapshot prefers own palette, then current primary palette, otherwise existing zero table; never binds inherited palette to surface. Actual portable C73524 checks include1024 raster cases overP8/RGB565/RGB555/ARGB32 and256 full palette snapshots,11 strict runtime mutants, old actual source negative control, ASAN/UBSAN. SDK XP covers surface1/2/3/4/7 ROP and GetDC/ReleaseDC wrappers,10 fills,20 full256-entry GetDIBColorTable queries,1280 real GDI SetPixelV calls and15 refusals. Explicit palette bindings are added only after DC queries/commit for indexed-copy previews, without claiming GetDC binds the fallback palette. Thirty actual readbacks have simulated transport replies; independent dual GPU replay validates1920 pixels and11 explicit texture destructions with empty guest maps before genuine owner release. Virtual8x8x8 mode is project transport setup, not native HAL mode validation. Live palette updates of already-open DCs, native system-palette emulation when no palette exists, GetDC readback-failure policy, full format/depth/compression ROP matrix, arbitrary ROP truth tables, callback/thread/loss/Reset/wrapper conversion, native HAL, games/FPS and overall stages4/5/6 remain open.
